approved_translation: Friendship and loyalty transcend differences; true friends care for each other.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Two Deer named Beauty and Brownie lived with their father and mother and great herds of Deer in a forest. One day their father called them to him and said: "The Deer in the forest are always in danger when the corn is ripening in the fields. Beauty led all his herd back, but stupid Brownie traveled in the daytime, and again he took his herd past the villages. When he reached the forest only a few were left of all Brownie's herd.
